analysis: The question asks for a 5α reductase inhibitor effective in both benign prostatic hypertrophy (BPH) and male pattern baldness. Among the options provided, Finasteride (opb) is the only medication that fits this description. It works by inhibiting the conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT), which is implicated in both conditions. Flutamide (opa) is an anti-androgen used primarily for prostate cancer and does not inhibit 5α reductase. Prazosin (opc) is an alpha-1 blocker used for hypertension and BPH but does not affect DHT levels. Minoxidil (opd) is a topical treatment for hair loss but is not a 5α reductase inhibitor and does not treat BPH. Therefore, the best-supported option is Finasteride, as it is clinically proven to be effective for both BPH and male pattern baldness.
